title: Business-Wrap webhook payload
description: The JSON body the editor's webhooks POST to a user-entered URL. Off by default, no default URLs. Delivered by the local server (POST /api/webhook), which forwards only the fields below: never fonts, never the tool watermark.

event.description: save = Save pressed; export = PDF + DOCX exported; edits.exported = edits bundle exported (one service or all); import.merged = an edits file or a colleague's Save-HTML merged; validation.failed = the Check panel turned red; test = the panel's Send test button.

changes.description: Live (not rejected) edits in this edition.

document.description: The full edited document JSON. Present only when the user ticked “Include the full document”.
